title: Chapter 43 Everything Is Over
content:
Chapter 43 Everything Is Over

However, when Lu Daosheng saw the silent warship in another void, his mouth twitched slightly.

That was the warship blueprint he got from the system store.

Although it was improved by him, it was not as powerful as before.

But it also had a terrifying destructive strike capability.

His original intention was to make this warship a sensation in the battle with the evil demons.

But now, the opponent was like a ghost ship, silently isolated aside.

Then, Lu Daosheng slowly came to the side of the warship, and suddenly, a dull sound came from the warship, as if crying out his unwillingness.

"Little ship, I'm sorry for you."

Lu Daosheng gently touched the bow of the warship, and for a moment, the whole warship began to tremble.

And on the battlefield.

With the addition of Huang Shou, the situation was reversed directly.

"Impossible! Impossible! How could a Earth Realm expert appear in your inferior world?!"

"What a bullshit Emperor Realm expert, I'm already in the Life and Death Realm, take my blow!"

The Great Yan Sect's ancestor didn't listen to the roar of the evil demon clan's expert at all, but fought more and more fiercely.

"Damn it, hurry up, report this matter!"

An evil demon king roared.

Then, the entire evil demon army began to gradually retreat.

Seeing this scene, all the creatures in the Hongmeng Universe were extremely excited.

They beat back the evil demon clan.

In the void, only Yunqi, Guchen and Huang Shou looked solemn.

They stared at the dark crack with a trace of solemnity in their eyes.

What kind of place would it be in there, and why would there be such a terrifying sense of crisis.

They were puzzled.

But they were not afraid, because behind them was Huangcheng and Lu Daosheng.

"Keep killing, don't let them run away!"

Rumble!

The explosions of the war continued to sound.

The entire boundary of the universe had already been shattered.

But everyone's eyes were full of hope, because they had seen the dawn of victory.

Look, there is really light!

But why is this light full of black air?

Boom!

A ray of light full of terrifying aura mixed with black air poured out from the crack of the boundary.

In an instant, all the creatures of the Hongmeng universe that came into contact with it fell into it.

That is not the dawn of victory, it is the strong man of the evil demon clan!

"No, block it!"

Yunqi, Guchen and Huang Shou immediately stepped forward and used all their magical powers to block the terrifying light in front of the army.

There was a loud bang.

Yunqi and Guchen retreated thousands of feet away.

And Huang Shou also retreated several steps, and every step made the entire void shatter.

It can be seen how powerful it is.

The three looked ahead solemnly.

For a moment, the entire battlefield was quiet for a moment.

"It's Lord Demon!"

The evil demons were immediately excited, staring at the crack with respect.

A great demon in black armor and holding a long sword slowly walked out of the crack.

A terrifying aura was constantly leaking out, shaking the entire universe boundary to collapse.

The style was directly pulled to the maximum.

"A group of inferior creatures dare to be presumptuous in front of my noble evil demons."

The demon king slowly spoke.

He looked at the creatures of the Hongmeng universe with a cold look.

Suddenly, all the creatures felt as if they fell into an ice cellar for thousands of years, and they were cold.

Huang Shou looked at the demon king, and the sword in his hand unconsciously tightened by three points.

This is a strong man who is above the entire battlefield. Why does such a strong man appear?

This evil demon clan can't afford to play.

But since you, the evil demon clan, can't afford it, don't blame someone in the dark for not being able to play either.

Snap!

A crisp snap of fingers sounded.

Suddenly, the entire battlefield became quiet, and an irresistible force suppressed all the creatures present.

Including the demon king.

For a moment, everyone was stunned.

But the people in the deserted city were overjoyed.

I saw that in the void, a man in a long robe and slow steps was walking slowly towards here.

It was Lu Daosheng.

"We are here to meet the Lord of the City!"

Yunqi and others shouted excitedly at the first time.

In an instant, everyone looked at the figure in disbelief.

Some people knew, some people didn't.

On the side of the deserted city, everyone, without exception, looked at Lu Daosheng with respect.

Many of them saw Lu Daosheng for the first time.

Is this the great Lord of the Deserted City?

It's true that they are not comparable to mortals like them. This is simply a god.

"Who are you?"

In the void, the demon king was also full of disbelief, and a deep fear gradually surged in his heart.

Why would such a strong man appear in such a small world?

However, Lu Daosheng did not have the demon king. He just waved his hand, and all the creatures in the Hongmeng universe recovered and appeared behind Lu Daosheng.

"Now, it's time to end it."

Lu Daosheng looked at the messy Hongmeng universe in front of him and said slowly.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand and clenched it.

The boundary crack that was torn apart by the evil demon clan with brute force healed instantly.

Seeing this scene, the evil demon clan seemed to have seen a ghost.

What kind of heaven-defying method is this.

And they also know that they are finished.

They didn't even have a way out.

The Demon Lord, who knew that he would die, stared at Lu Daosheng and said, "You will be punished by my evil demon clan. If you have the affair, you will never be here for the rest of your life."

As long as Lu Daosheng dares to go to the world of all spirits, he believes that Lu Daosheng will definitely die.

Because the strength of their evil demon clan is unimaginable to this small world.

If it weren't for some factors that the real strong people in their clan could not enter this small world, their evil demon clan would have eaten up the creatures here long ago.

Those who are as strong as him are not even considered a nonsense among their evil demon clan.

But sending him to this world consumed considerable resources from their evil demon clan.

But in the end, he still failed.

When he heard the Demon Lord's words, Lu Daosheng immediately looked at him with a smile.

"Don't worry, I'll go to your place soon, and then you will be able to meet your companions soon."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand, and in an instant, all the evil demons in the Hongmeng Universe were wiped out.

Seeing this scene, everyone behind Lu Daosheng was already stunned.

Bang!

Old Yang knelt directly at Lu Daosheng and said with tears in his eyes: "Thank you, senior, for saving the entire Hongmeng Universe."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng's expression changed slightly, and he quickly dragged Mr. Yang up.

"It's not possible, it's not possible."

This is the real veteran of the Hongmeng Universe today.

On the other hand, some of the old seniors of the Hongmeng Universe who had not yet completely died were full of smiles when they looked at all.

"I didn't expect that there are also strong people like you in my Hongmeng Universe. We are relieved to be in the future of Hongmeng Universe."

As soon as the words were finished, those strong people would dissipate into the Hongmeng Universe and become history completely.

And at this moment, Lu Daosheng took action.

As Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand and grabbed it.

The souls of those old seniors suddenly solidified.

"You guys are willing to join my deserted city."

Lu Daosheng spoke.

Hearing this, all of those people were stunned.

After a long time, a man trembled and said, "Senior, we have no future."

"I can give you the future."

Lu Daosheng said directly.

Suddenly, the old seniors took a deep breath and bowed directly to Lu Daosheng.

"We are willing to join the wasteland city."

Although they don’t know about the deserted city, they know that it’s enough for them to continue to live.

Unexpectedly, I was almost buried in my old age and I could still get such an opportunity.

It really fits that sentence.

Don't bully the elderly and poor.

Seeing these people agree, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and then took all these powerful people into the world in his palm.

He wants to build the most elite force, and these people, if only one person says, is himself.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's eyes swept over everyone present.

Even though they had just experienced a great war, the eyes of everyone were full of hope.

That is hope for the future.

"Everyone, from now on, my Hongmeng Universe will be worry-free."

As soon as the words came to an end, the entire void was filled with cheering sounds.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's name also spread throughout the Hongmeng Universe.

Countless years later, if you happen to come to the Hongmeng Universe, you will find that there are statues of great men everywhere.

And the statue himself is Lu Daosheng.
